name: clip2short
description: Clip2Short: AI clipping SaaS. Python (FastAPI) API, React web app and pre-rendered React landing page.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,landing,admin -c yellow,cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w landing" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.dev:api: uv --directory backend run uvicorn app.main:app --port 4000 --reload --reload-dir app
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w landing && npm run build -w admin
scripts.build:landing: npm install --include=dev && npm run build -w landing
scripts.build:web: npm install --include=dev && npm run build -w web
scripts.build:admin: npm install --include=dev && npm run build -w admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w landing && npm run typecheck -w admin
